about: Trial 1 (2026-09-23, round 07 targets): prompt wording only — Claude's call, inside the founder's rulings. E1 extends his 'What the driver states is fact' to changes that work the same way (s-02: rear toe gain after 'rear toe hasn't helped'). E2 makes the pair's second half recover only a cost the driver minds (s-05: thinner front oil to win back a calmer first input on a car he called hard to drive).

edits.find: What the driver states is fact; never re-suspect it.
edits.replace: What the driver states is fact; never re-suspect it, and a change they say didn't help rules out the ones that work the same way.
edits.why: s-02 try A: 'take 0.5 shim out of the rear toe-gain stack' straight after 'Rear toe hasn't helped' — his never.

edits.find: where that change costs a part of the corner, the change that gets it back
edits.replace: where that change costs something the driver still wants, the change that gets it back
edits.why: s-05 both tries: softer front bar, then thinner front oil to bring back the first input — on a car he said is hard to drive; his never: 'thinner oil would make reactivity worse'.
